blind.description: An architectural corbel or wall bracket shaped like a red devil/fiend face. The top surface forms a flat rectangular shelf with dark grey banded trim. Underneath, a sculpted red demonic visage with dark curved horns, pointed ears, a beard, and furrowed brows serves as the main support, flanked by carved side scrolls. The back shows subtle ornamental relief carving. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or holes.
blind.from_above: A rectangular red surface bounded by dark grey border straps, with two small dark horn tips protruding slightly past the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/3 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2 feet tall) and about 1.8 feet wide.
